title: Binance Wallet Launches the Binance Alpha Earn Hub: Add Liquidity to Earn High APR Rewards and Alpha Points
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Binance Wallet is excited to launch the Binance Alpha Earn Hub — a new feature that lets users add liquidity to eligible Binance Alpha token pools and earn APR rewards from trading fees. By doing so, users also accumulate Binance Alpha Points, increasing their eligibility for exclusive events like Token Generation Events (TGEs) and airdrops.  About Binance Alpha Earn Hub With the Binance Alpha Earn Hub, users can seamlessly  provide liquidity on PancakeSwap V3  directly from the Binance Wallet interface. PancakeSwap V3 allows you to concentrate liquidity within a custom price range improving capital efficiency and potentially increasing trading fee earnings. To make this easier, the Alpha Earn Hub offers three preset strategies: Wide:  Liquidity concentrated in a wider range to maximize active time in the pool and reduce the need for frequent adjustments.  Medium:  Liquidity concentrated in a balanced approach between capital efficiency and active coverage of the price range. Narrow:  Liquidity concentrated in a narrower range of the current price aiming for higher fee rewards requires active management of your positions. Note: Narrower ranges may lead to higher fee rewards, but carry a greater risk of earning nothing during large price fluctuations.You can also choose to provide liquidity across the full price range; however, this approach typically results in lower fee income, reduced capital efficiency, and increased exposure to impermanent loss. We encourage all users to conduct their own research to choose a strategy that aligns with their risk appetite and goals. Update to Binance Alpha Points System: PancakeSwap V3 Liquidity Providers Now Eligible Starting from 2025-06-11, the Binance Alpha Points system has been updated to include eligible liquidity positions in the Binance Wallet as part of your Balance Points calculation. Specifically, positions held in PancakeSwap V3 liquidity pools (LP) accessed via the Binance Alpha Earn Hub in Binance Wallet will now contribute to your Alpha Points balance. This means that by adding liquidity through the Alpha Earn Hub, users can now also earn Binance Alpha Balance Points — increasing their eligibility for exclusive opportunities such as Token Generation Events (TGEs) and Alpha token airdrops. To qualify, one side of the LP trading pair must be a Binance Alpha token, while the other must be a token listed on the Binance Spot Market. Examples of eligible LP pairs: Alpha token <> USDT Alpha token <> BNB This update reflects our continued efforts to reward genuine, active participation within the Binance Alpha ecosystem and to give users more ways to grow their Alpha Points through meaningful activity. For full details, please refer to the  Binance Alpha Points FAQ . How to Get Started Update your Binance App to the latest version and go to  [Assets] . Tap  [Wallet]  >  [Earn] . Tap the  [Binance Alpha Earn Hub]  banner or   go to  [Liquidity Pools],  then select a supported Alpha token pair that meets the eligibility criteria. Set your desired price range or select a preset strategy. Provide liquidity and start earning APR rewards and Binance Alpha Points. Explore Binance Alpha Earn Hub Now! Notes: Providing liquidity in concentrated pools involves risks, such as impermanent loss, price range exposure and market volatility.  APR Rewards are generated from the trading fee from only when the market price remains within your specified liquidity range. Actual APR may vary from the displayed APR based on trading volume, fee tier, the price range you select and how much liquidity you provide. Unclaimed fees may take some time to update. If you have recently claimed fees, please check back later as the system may not reflect updates immediately. Your specified price range may require an active management of your positions. Please do your own research and make sure you understand how concentrated liquidity pools work before committing. Effective 2025-06-17 00:00 (UTC), Alpha Token <> Alpha Token LP balances will  no longer  count toward Binance Alpha Points. More Information: How to Provide Liquidity for Binance Alpha Tokens on PancakeSwap V3 Frequently Asked Questions on Binance Alpha Points For updates and more information, follow  Binance Wallet’s official X account .  Note:  There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support!
